source_snapshot.items: AC Reboot - pciePoll() - Check all PCIEs on the bus
source_snapshot.procedure: wat_runner.py BMC_IP --cycles 250 -s AC BMC_P DC OS OS_I BMC_I.
source_snapshot.criteria: System workable and no system-log error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Calls the case AC reboot with pciePoll but proposes a command that omits the source AC token.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED until corrected scenario, PCIe identity/link baseline and exact AC method are approved.

old_problem: The AC-reboot PCIe polling objective conflicts with the proposed WAT token sequence; the proprietary AC stimulus and per-device PCIe identity/link oracle are not authoritative.
disposition_reason: ED-03 forbids guessed OEM scenario parameters, ED-06 and ED-18 preserve the exact AC transition, and ED-19 preserves this PCIe-specific identity. Parameterizing BDFs cannot resolve a command that may invoke a different physical cycle.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row84 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3108 and actual next row86/history3109 were read.
The source command contains AC while the proposed command removes it; no signed WAT definition proves those sequences equivalent.
PCIe count alone is insufficient because devices can change BDF, disappear, or return down-trained; the oracle needs serial/root-port/capable-versus-current link identity per cycle.
No WAT command, AC action or DUT test ran; the distinct 250-cycle PCIe coverage remains blocked rather than reduced.

test_case.test_name: NVIDIA WAT 250 AC reboot cycles with per-cycle PCIe identity and link polling
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved PCIe endpoint returns with the expected identity, root-port relationship and link state after each of 250 physical AC reboot cycles.
required_package: Owner-approved WAT version/checksum and corrected AC/pciePoll scenario tokens
Rated AC fixture/feed mapping, off/on/discharge dwell and auto-power behavior
Signed PCIe serial/device/BDF/root-port/capable-current width-speed baseline and allowed changes
Secure endpoints plus per-cycle readiness/AER/abort/OOB recovery contract
test_case.test_command: Do not execute. After scenario approval, run the exact signed WAT AC/pciePoll command for 250 cycles on a dedicated SUT and correlate every endpoint by stable identity/root port while recording link state, AER and BMC/OS readiness each cycle.
test_case.expected_result: All 250 approved AC cycles complete and every baseline PCIe endpoint returns at an allowed location with expected negotiated link and no disallowed AER, readiness or power event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is unavailable until the proprietary scenario is approved. Afterwards PASS requires all 250 per-cycle identity/root-port/link/AER comparisons; final lspci count, DC/warm reboot, fewer cycles or retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT, rated AC controller and explicit authorization
Secure secrets, verified OOB and signed PCIe baseline
Preserve logs; abort on missing/down-trained device, AER, boot-loop, power or thermal fault
No automatic retry and no AC/DC/warm substitution
test_case.recovery: Fail fast, preserve the failed cycle and PCIe topology, stop the AC controller safely, restore nominal power/services through the approved OOB procedure, compare the final topology, and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The source AC token and the same-row DeepSeek command disagree; proprietary token semantics are unresolved.

blocked.reason: The physical power stimulus and exact PCIe acceptance contract cannot be selected safely from conflicting inputs.
